usage.callShape: GET https://api.x402node.dev/text/translate?text=<text>&to=<langcode> (x402 paid, ~$0.005/call on Base). NOT POST — POST returns 404.
usage.outputShape: body.text_out (translated text), body.text_in, body.source_lang (auto-detected), body.target_lang, body.processing_ms
quirks: Registry lists method POST and price Free — BOTH WRONG. Real method is GET and it costs ~$0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base.
POST to /text/translate returns 404 'Cannot POST /text/translate'. Must use GET.
Params go in the query string, NOT a JSON body: ?text=...&to=... . 'text' is required, 'to' is optional (target language code like zh, es, fr).
Param names are 'text' and 'to' — NOT MyMemory's q/langpair. Using q/langpair returns 400 with hint '?text=... required, optional &to=lang'.
Source language is auto-detected (no 'from' param needed); returned as body.source_lang.
usage.guide: Call GET https://api.x402node.dev/text/translate with query params text (the string to translate, required) and to (target language code such as zh, es, fr; optional, defaults applied server-side). It is an x402 paid endpoint (~$0.005 USDC on Base per call) despite the registry saying Free. Do NOT POST and do NOT send a JSON body — POST returns 404 and JSON bodies are ignored; everything goes in the query string. Read the translated text from body.text_out; source language is auto-detected and returned as body.source_lang.
